key.name: size-scale
key.description: Scales the width of the expanded capsule.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the capsule in pixels.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: How opaque the capsule background is.

key.name: animation-speed
key.description: Multiplier for the speed of all capsule animations.

key.name: open-on-hover
key.description: Open the capsule when the pointer rests on it. If off, it opens on click only.

key.name: auto-collapse
key.description: Close the expanded capsule shortly after the pointer leaves it.

key.name: activities-in-collapsed
key.summary: Show activities in the collapsed capsule
key.description: Show a running timer, music or an upcoming meeting instead of the time while collapsed.

key.name: localsend-receive
key.description: Makes this computer visible to LocalSend devices on the network (it listens on port 53317). Every transfer has to be accepted in a card; files are saved in the Downloads folder. Off by default.

key.name: free-super-v
key.description: GNOME opens its notification list on Super+V. While this is on and Osmin is enabled, that default binding is taken away so Super+V (or Super+M) can be used for a Osmin shortcut; it is given back when Osmin is disabled.

key.name: saved-message-tray-binding
key.summary: GNOME's own toggle-message-tray binding, saved while it is freed
key.description: Internal: restored when Osmin is disabled, or at the next start if the shell stopped without disabling Osmin.

key.name: shortcut-osmin
key.description: Opens the panel on the Osmin section (or closes it if that section is already shown). Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: shortcut-tray
key.description: Opens the panel on the Tray section (or closes it if that section is already shown). Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: shortcut-clipboard
key.description: Opens the panel on the Clipboard section (or closes it if that section is already shown). Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: shortcut-alerts
key.description: Opens the panel on the Alerts section (or closes it if that section is already shown). Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: monitors
key.description: Where Osmin is shown: 'primary' (whichever monitor is the primary one) and/or connector names such as 'HDMI-1'. Monitors that are not connected are ignored.

key.name: enabled-widgets
key.description: The widgets shown in the expanded capsule, in display order.

key.name: widget-cells
key.description: The width of each widget in cells.

key.name: width-mode
key.description: auto: the width follows the enabled widgets. fixed: a share of the screen width.

key.name: fixed-width
key.description: The width of the expanded capsule as a share of the screen width (fixed width mode).

key.name: row-height
key.description: Height of the widget area in pixels.

key.name: content-padding
key.description: Space around the widgets in pixels.

key.name: widget-spacing
key.description: Space between widgets in pixels.

key.name: show-dividers
key.description: Thin lines between widgets.

key.name: shadow-strength
key.description: How strong the shadow under the capsule is.

key.name: gestures-swipe-open
key.description: Scrolling or swiping down over the collapsed capsule opens it.

key.name: gestures-swipe-close
key.description: Scrolling or swiping up over the open capsule closes it.

key.name: gestures-media-swipe
key.description: While music is playing, swiping left or right over the collapsed capsule goes to the previous or next track.

key.name: gestures-invert
key.description: Reverses the direction of every swipe gesture.

key.name: gestures-middle-click
key.description: What a middle click on the collapsed capsule does.

key.name: shortcut-apps
key.description: Desktop file ids of the apps shown in the Shortcuts widget, in order.

key.name: shortcut-columns
key.description: How many columns of shortcuts (two rows each) the widget shows.

key.name: collapsed-width-adjust
key.description: Makes the collapsed capsule wider or narrower, in pixels.

key.name: clipboard-keep-history
key.description: Save everything you copied on disk and restore it after a restart. Pinned items and notes are always saved.

key.name: clipboard-max-items
key.description: How many unpinned items the clipboard history keeps.

key.name: clipboard-click-pastes
key.description: Clicking an item puts it in the app you were using (Ctrl+V). If off, it is only copied.

key.name: panel-color
key.description: The colour of the top bar while Osmin is enabled, as #rrggbb.

key.name: panel-opacity
key.description: How opaque the top bar is while Osmin is enabled. 0 is fully transparent.

key.name: tray-keep-files
key.description: Remember the files in the tray after a restart or logout.

key.name: album-corner-radius
key.description: The corner radius of the album art, in pixels.

key.name: media-effect
key.description: The animation shown while music plays: bars (spectrum) or waves.

key.name: colored-effects
key.description: Tint the music effect with the colour of the album art; otherwise it is white.

key.name: activity-media
key.description: Show the music that is playing as a live activity.

key.name: activity-timer
key.description: Show a running timer as a live activity.

key.name: activity-calendar
key.description: Show a meeting that is about to start as a live activity.

key.name: activity-files
key.description: Show a card when files are added to the tray.

key.name: peek-media-seconds
key.description: How many seconds the card with the new track stays on screen.

key.name: peek-files-seconds
key.description: How many seconds the "Adding / Added files" card stays on screen.

key.name: peek-calendar-seconds
key.description: How many seconds the card about an upcoming meeting stays on screen.
